verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm that Docusign's REST API is versioned: users cite the v2 REST API and a legacy API version. No first-party evidence documents a deprecation or sunset policy, and one user says the legacy version came with no promise against sunsetting. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of API versioning, a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, independent confirmation of version stability guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: We use the v2 REST API creating embedded envelope signing URLs without issues.
DocuSign's fix required shifting to a legacy API version
